findings.reason: the decision to keep `FIGURE_REVIEW_ITEMS` and delete the parser is unaffected either way; only the stated reason describes a test as production.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — every symbol §22 cites resolves (`parse_figure_review` `reckon/crew/review.py:944`, `_FIGURE_RUBRIC_LINE_RE` `:544`, `_PLAN_RUBRIC_LINE_RE` `:1013`, `FIGURE_REVIEW_ITEMS` `:277`, `store_review` `:2562`, `read_review` `:3985`, `tests/test_figure_review.py`), but §6 `:2560` still names the parser §22 deletes.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when is a grep-absence plus a declared negative control (one `FIGURE_REVIEW_ITEMS` entry removed from `reckon/crew/prompts/figure_review.md`, which fails the surviving prompt assertion at `tests/test_figure_review.py:287`).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — logs are required under the run directory, starting with their revision and the literal command and ending in `EXIT=`, the same durable form §14–§20 use.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach the changed symbols or paths; the section text and the source names it edits carry none.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause (nothing in production calls `parse_figure_review`) is confirmed by a repo-wide search, and deletion is what produces the done-when.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable: delete the unreached parser and the test's parser assertions, keeping the prompt/brief assertions.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` wires `s22` to `scoring-should-stop-a-promotion#s6`, the section whose landed parser it removes, and the node needs no other edge (no gate, no informs).
